prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: separate opaque terrain patch for a top-down 2D anime aerial game, not a finished scene or UI.
Draw a square canopy of dense temperate broadleaf forest with a REAL empty clearing cut out of the middle. The camera is almost straight overhead with a slight view of the top-left sides of tree crowns, no horizon. Hand-painted Japanese anime background / high-quality 2D game scenery. Broad soft chunky leaf clusters with small sharp lobed leaf silhouettes, matt textured painterly highlights, bright yellow-green crown tops at upper-left and deep cool blue-green forest shadows at lower-right. Approximate tree crown diameter 140-180 pixels in a 1024 square; the forest is dense and continuous at all four square edges.
Main requirement: the trees have been REMOVED from the central clearing. This is an opening looking down to the forest FLOOR, not a bright round lawn lying on the tree canopy. Clear land extends approximately x=20%-79%, y=27%-83%. ALL of x=25%-73%, y=32%-75% must be tree-free, flat and usable to place a separately rendered stone arch and two broken pillars later. No actual structures in this image. Give the clearing an asymmetric irregular outline with broad lobes and dark recesses, no circle or oval. Make the cleared floor visibly below surrounding crowns, with soft dark cool green tree shadows falling inward onto the floor. Floor is muted mossy olive green short grass mixed with patches of warm olive-brown earth, a few tiny fallen leaves, sparse roots only near the far edge. Center usable open land is uncluttered. A few shrubs only at the forest margin. Match the foliage palette to olive/lime crown highlights and dark teal lower foliage; avoid yellow, neon or oversaturated clearing ground. Neutral daytime light for later runtime night grading.
Constraints: no tree or bush within the central usable footprint; no arch, pillars, stumps, paving, building, bridge, river, road, water, cliff, floating island, cutaway slab, magical glow, fog, text, label, UI, border or frame. Opaque foliage-filled square with no solid-color or transparent exterior. The forest floor and bordering canopy must read as one coherent landscape.

REMOVE the tree crowns in two connected irregular areas. A small upper usable open ground lies x=42%-68%, y=16%-39%; a broader lower-left usable ground lies x=15%-57%, y=47%-77%.
